title: 10.7 Circles in the Coordinate Plane

icans: I can write the equation of a circle from its center and radius.
I can find the center and radius of a circle from its equation and graph it.
I can decide whether a point is on, inside, or outside a circle.

vocab: (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r², where (h, k) is the __________ and r is the radius
the point inside a circle that is the same ___________ from every point on the circle
a __________ from the center to a point on the circle (or its length)

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Standard equation of a circle: (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r², with center _______________ and radius _______________. With the center at the origin: x² + y² = r².
